intro: This is a mantra from the **Samaveda** (Samaveda tradition, Kena Upanishad invocation). Below are the Sanskrit text and a **plain English meaning**.
takeaways: Source: Samaveda tradition, Kena Upanishad invocation.
The four Vedas are Rigveda, Yajurveda, Samaveda and Atharvaveda.
Vedic mantras are learned by listening and repeating.

p: **ॐ आप्यायन्तु ममाङ्गानि वाक्प्राणश्चक्षुः श्रोत्रमथो बलमिन्द्रियाणि च सर्वाणि ॥**
May all my limbs grow strong: speech, breath, eye, ear, strength and all the senses.
The Samaveda is one of the four Vedas, the oldest scriptures of Sanatana Dharma, handed down by voice for thousands of years.

faq.a: May all my limbs grow strong: speech, breath, eye, ear, strength and all the senses.
There are **four**: Rig, Yajur, Sama and Atharva.

note: The Sanskrit is the traditional text. The English is our own plain rendering.
